transform_insert_overwrite_select_transf.sql: FROM (FROM src SELECT TRANSFORM (a, b) USING 'my_script' AS c1, c2 CLUSTER BY c1) m INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dest SELECT TRANSFORM (m.c1, m.c2) USING 'my_reduce_script' AS d1, d2;

cluster_by.sql: SELECT key FROM src UNION ALL SELECT key FROM src1 CLUSTER BY key;

distribute_by.sql: SELECT key FROM src UNION ALL SELECT key FROM src1 DISTRIBUTE BY key;

except.sql: SELECT key FROM src EXCEPT SELECT key FROM src1;

except_all.sql: SELECT key FROM src EXCEPT ALL SELECT key FROM src1;

intersect.sql: SELECT key FROM src INTERSECT SELECT key FROM src1;

intersect_all.sql: SELECT key FROM src INTERSECT ALL SELECT key FROM src1;

intersect_distinct.sql: SELECT key FROM src INTERSECT DISTINCT SELECT key FROM src1;

minus.sql: SELECT key FROM src MINUS SELECT key FROM src1;

order_by_limit.sql: SELECT key FROM src UNION SELECT key FROM src1 ORDER BY key LIMIT 10;

parenthesized_operands.sql: (SELECT key FROM src ORDER BY key LIMIT 10) UNION ALL (SELECT key FROM src1 ORDER BY key LIMIT 10);

sort_by.sql: SELECT key FROM src UNION ALL SELECT key FROM src1 SORT BY key;

subquery_order_limit.sql: SELECT key FROM (SELECT key FROM src ORDER BY key LIMIT 10) subq1 UNION SELECT key FROM (SELECT key FROM src1 ORDER BY key LIMIT 10) subq2;

union.sql: SELECT key FROM src UNION SELECT key FROM src1;

union_all.sql: SELECT key FROM src UNION ALL SELECT key FROM src1;

union_chained.sql: SELECT key FROM a UNION ALL SELECT key FROM b UNION DISTINCT SELECT key FROM c;

union_distinct.sql: SELECT key FROM src UNION DISTINCT SELECT key FROM src1;

union_in_ctas.sql: CREATE TABLE t AS SELECT key FROM a UNION ALL SELECT key FROM b;

union_in_from.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT key FROM a UNION ALL SELECT key FROM b) unionResult;

union_in_from_join.sql: SELECT u.id, actions.date FROM (SELECT av.uid AS uid FROM action_video av WHERE av.date = '2008-06-03' UNION ALL SELECT ac.uid AS uid FROM action_comment ac WHERE ac.date = '2008-06-03') actions JOIN users u ON (u.id = actions.uid);

union_in_insert.sql: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE t SELECT key FROM a UNION ALL SELECT key FROM b;

union_in_view.sql: CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT key FROM a UNION ALL SELECT key FROM b;

aggregate_in_over.sql: SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(b)) FROM t GROUP BY a;

count_distinct_over_frame.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) FROM t;

count_distinct_over_partition.sql: SELECT a, COUNT(DISTINCT a) OVER (PARTITION BY b) FROM t;

distribution_functions.sql: SELECT CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY a), PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a), NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY a) FROM t;

first_value_skip_nulls.sql: SELECT a, FIRST_VALUE(a, true) OVER (PARTITION BY b ORDER BY c) FROM t;

lag_offset_default.sql: SELECT a, LAG(a, 3, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY b ORDER BY c) FROM t;

last_value.sql: SELECT a, LAST_VALUE(a) OVER (PARTITION BY b ORDER BY c ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM t;

lead_default.sql: SELECT a, LEAD(a) OVER (PARTITION BY b ORDER BY c) FROM t;

lead_offset.sql: SELECT a, LEAD(a, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY b ORDER BY c) FROM t;

multiple_over_clauses.sql: SELECT a, COUNT(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c), SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c) FROM t;

over_empty.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER () FROM t;

over_order_desc.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d DESC) FROM t;

over_order_only.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER (ORDER BY d) FROM t;

over_partition_by.sql: SELECT a, COUNT(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c) FROM t;

over_partition_by_multi.sql: SELECT a, COUNT(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c, d) FROM t;

over_partition_order.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d) FROM t;

over_with_aliases.sql: SELECT a, COUNT(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c) AS b_count, SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c) b_sum FROM t;

range_current_unbounded_following.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM t;

range_n_preceding_n_following.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d RANGE BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) FROM t;

range_unbounded_preceding_current.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM t;

ranking_functions.sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a), DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b ORDER BY a) FROM t;

rows_current_current.sql: SELECT a, AVG(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW) FROM t;

rows_current_n_following.sql: SELECT a, AVG(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM t;

rows_current_unbounded_following.sql: SELECT a, AVG(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM t;

rows_n_following_n_following.sql: SELECT a, AVG(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 3 FOLLOWING) FROM t;

rows_n_following_unbounded.sql: SELECT a, AVG(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM t;

rows_n_preceding_current.sql: SELECT a, AVG(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM t;

rows_n_preceding_n_following.sql: SELECT a, AVG(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) FROM t;

rows_n_preceding_unbounded_following.sql: SELECT a, AVG(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM t;

rows_unbounded_preceding_current.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM t;

rows_unbounded_preceding_n_preceding.sql: SELECT a, AVG(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) FROM t;

rows_unbounded_preceding_shorthand.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) FROM t;

window_clause.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER w FROM t WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING);

window_clause_multiple.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER w1, AVG(b) OVER w2 FROM t WINDOW w1 AS (PARTITION BY c), w2 AS (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d);

window_reference_in_over.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) OVER (w ORDER BY d) FROM t WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c);

from_db.sql: SHOW COLUMNS FROM t FROM db;

in_db.sql: SHOW COLUMNS IN t IN db;

like_db.sql: SHOW COLUMNS FROM t FROM db LIKE 'col*';

filtered.sql: SHOW COMPACTIONS db.t PARTITION (ds='2008-04-08') POOL_NAME 'p' TYPE 'MAJOR' STATE 'initiated' ORDER BY start DESC LIMIT 10;

role_on_all.sql: SHOW GRANT ROLE r ON ALL;

user_on_table.sql: SHOW GRANT USER u ON TABLE t;

formatted_from_db.sql: SHOW FORMATTED INDEXES ON t FROM db;

all_clauses.sql: SHOW PARTITIONS db.t PARTITION(ds='2010-03-03') WHERE hr >= 10 ORDER BY hr DESC LIMIT 10;

order_by.sql: SHOW PARTITIONS db.t ORDER BY hr DESC;

from_database.sql: SHOW TABLE EXTENDED FROM db LIKE 'part*';

in_database.sql: SHOW TABLE EXTENDED IN db LIKE 'part*';

expression_value.sql: UPDATE t SET c = c + 1, d = CAST(e AS STRING) WHERE id > 5 AND f IS NOT NULL;

function_value.sql: UPDATE t SET c = upper(d), e = NULL WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3);

where.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WHERE id = 5;

cte_create_view.sql: CREATE VIEW v AS WITH q AS (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT c FROM q;

cte_ctas.sql: CREATE TABLE s AS WITH q AS (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT c FROM q;

cte_in_subquery.sql: SELECT c FROM (WITH q AS (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT c FROM q) x;

cte_insert.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT c FROM t) INSERT INTO s SELECT c FROM q;

cte_referencing_earlier.sql: WITH q1 AS (SELECT c FROM t), q2 AS (SELECT c FROM q1) SELECT c FROM q2;

cte_union.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT c FROM q UNION ALL SELECT c FROM q;

multiple_ctes.sql: WITH q1 AS (SELECT c FROM t), q2 AS (SELECT c FROM s) SELECT q1.c FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.c = q2.c;

single_cte.sql: WITH q1 AS (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT c FROM q1;
